meta.name: arbor
meta.description: Autonomously improve a real artifact (code, training recipe, agent harness, data pipeline, prompt) against an objective and an evaluator, using Hypothesis Tree Refinement (HTR) from the Arbor paper. Use this whenever someone wants to iteratively optimize something over many experiments without overfitting — e.g. "get my model's eval score up", "improve this agent/harness", "tune this pipeline", "beat the baseline on this benchmark", "run a search over approaches and keep the best", "do an MLE-bench / Kaggle-style optimization", or any long-horizon "make this artifact better and don't just memorize the dev set" task. Trigger it even when the user doesn't say "Arbor" or "hypothesis tree" but describes repeated experiment-and-evaluate loops, branching exploration of competing ideas, or worries about a dev/test gap. Runs Claude itself as the coordinator with subagent executors in isolated git worktrees; for the standalone `arbor` CLI tool see references/arbor-upstream.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让系统自动跑实验,持续优化代码与模型效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你总在反复调参做实验,希望系统自动帮你找到更好的方案
copy.tagline_en: Run iterative experiments to keep improving your code and model results
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're tired of manually tweaking models and want the system to find the best approach for you

howto.what: 装了这个技能,Claude 会把你的改进任务变成自动实验循环:它记录目标和评估方法,反复尝试不同改法并打分,维护一棵假设树,只把通过独立测试评估的改动合并,最后给出实验报告。
howto.when: 当你想通过多轮实验迭代改进一个具体工件(如代码、模型、数据管道、提示词),并有可打分的评估器时。例如想让模型分数更高、改进 agent、“调管道”等。

say.text: 帮我提高这个模型的评估分数,别在开发集上过拟合
say.note: Claude 会初始化假设树,开始自动实验。

say.text: 用 Arbor 优化我的数据管道,目标是降低损失
say.note: 会先确认目标和评估器,然后跑多轮实验。

say.text: 改进这个 agent 的准确率,用独立测试集把关
say.note: 会设置开发/测试分离,只合并测试通过者。

howto.what_en: Claude runs an automated improvement loop: it keeps a hypothesis tree, tries changes in isolated worktrees, scores each with a dev evaluator, merges only those that pass a held-out test, and writes a final report.
howto.when_en: When the user wants to iteratively improve a concrete artifact (code, model, pipeline, prompt) under an evaluator—e.g., raising an eval score, improving an agent/harness, tuning a pipeline—even if they don't say 'Arbor'.

say_en.text: Boost this model's eval score without overfitting the dev set.
say_en.note: Claude will initialize a hypothesis tree and start automated trials.

say_en.text: Use Arbor to tune my data pipeline to reduce loss.
say_en.note: It will confirm the objective and evaluator, then run experiments.

say_en.text: Improve this agent's accuracy, gated by a separate test set.
say_en.note: A dev/test split will be enforced; only test-verified changes merge.
